integrity: The 2024 source motivates the orbit-resolved expansion question; the map itself first appeared in a 2016 precursor explicitly credited in the result. All checks are internal mathematical review, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to the phase-zero Blaschke toral family and primitive period-two orbits; no global splitting regularity or higher-period classification is claimed. Singular parameter one is excluded.
title: Two distinct exact prime-two Lyapunov spectra in a Blaschke Anosov torus map
